title: T1588 — Obtain Capabilities
subtitle: Interactive walkthrough of Obtain Capabilities with the technique-specific attack path and defender evidence.
aria: Attack simulation, step 1 of 8. Planning the campaign. The attacker lists what the attack needs: a stealer for credentials, a post-exploitation tool, and a valid code signing certificate so files look trusted.

steps.defender: Test samples leak into sandboxes and repositories. A hash now exists that intelligence can match later.

steps.title: Delivering to the target
steps.caption: The attacker sends phishing mail with a link to the staging server. The payload is correctly signed, so endpoint warnings stay quiet.
steps.defender: The mail gateway sees a valid signature but a low-reputation sender. One weak signal appears and is usually not enough to alert alone.

steps.title: First beacon from the victim
steps.caption: A user opens the lure. The implant calls the staging server over HTTPS and waits for instructions.
steps.defender: Proxy and DNS logs now hold a connection to a days-old domain. Paired with the CT alert from step 4, this is a strong signal.

steps.caption: Threat intelligence matches the hash, the certificate, and the domain. The SOC pivots on the certificate identity and finds the infected host within a day.
